name: architecture-skills
description: Agent skills for software architecture. c4-diagrams analyzes a local repository (.NET, Java/Kotlin, Go, Node.js/TypeScript, Python) and generates C4 model diagrams (context, container, component, code), key-flow, deployment, API and configuration views, and evidence-based recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: C4 diagrams and an architecture report for a local repository
interface.longDescription: Analyze a .NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python or Java repository and produce C4 model diagrams (system context, containers, components), a Markdown architecture report with the full dependency graph, and recommendations backed by evidence from the code.
defaultPrompt: Generate C4 architecture diagrams for this repository.
Review the architecture of this repository.
